name: CHIN 3230W
title: Language and Identity in Greater China
description: The role of language, linguistic indexing of socio-economic class, dialects and regional language variation, impact of state policies, linguistic  borrowings, bilingualism and bicultural identity, and language shift and attrition in greater China. Taught in English. CA 1. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; instructor consent required.
